English: 1 Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in me also believes in the one who sent me. 2 Whoever looks at me sees the one who sent me. 3 I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes may remain in darkness. 4 If anyone hears my words but does not obey them, I do not judge him, for I did not come to judge the world, but to save it. 5 Anyone who rejects me and doesn’t accept my message has already been judged, because the word I speak will be his condemnation. 6 These things I told you so that when the time comes you will remember that I warned you. 7 “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus replied, “I am the gate for the sheep. 8 All those who came before me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them. 9 I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved, and they will come in and go out and find pasture. 10 The thief comes only to steal, kill, and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full. 11 “I am the good shepherd. Kiswahili: Askari waliporudi kambini, wazee wa Israeli wakawauliza, “Kwa nini Bwana ameruhusu leo tushindwe mbele ya Wafilisti? Tuleteni Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kutoka Shilo, ili lipate kwenda pamoja nasi, na kutuokoa kutoka mikono ya adui zetu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero abarwani abatigarete bairanete gocha ase egetwori, abagaaka b’Abaisraeli bagateeba: “Nase ki Omonene atotiga twabugwa n’Abafilisti ase rituko ria reero? Togende torente korwa Silo Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene, erinde eche ebe egati yaito na gototooria korwa ase amaboko yababisa baito.”

English: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
Kiswahili: Kijana aifanye njia yake kuwa safi jinsi gani? Ni kwa kutii, akilifuata neno lako.
Ekegusii: Naki omonto omosae arakore arende obochenu bw’obogima bwaye? Nase okorenda orogeendo rwaye kobwatekana ne ring’ana riao.

English: The case was adjourned until December 13th and will be heard again on December 5th of this year.
Ekegusii: Ekina ekio nigo kegochi gokwanwa chitariki 13 chio omotienyi oyo na gotegererwa chitariki 5 chio omotienyi o 5 bwo omwaka oyo.

English: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to Yahweh’s house?”
Kiswahili: Hezekia alikuwa ameuliza, “Kutakuwa na ishara gani kwamba nitapanda kwenda Hekalu la Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Boigo Hezekia konya oboririe iga: “Nkemanyererio ki gekonyorokia ng’a ningende ase enyomba y’Omonene?”

English: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
Kiswahili: Mtumaini Bwana kwa moyo wako wote wala usizitegemee akili zako mwenyewe;
Ekegusii: Osemerie Omonene n’enkoro yao yonsi; tobaisa gosemeria okomanya kwao.

English: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi wapendwa, jijengeni katika imani yenu iliyo takatifu sana tena ombeni katika Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe, abanchani, mweagache ase okwegena kwaino kore ogochenu mono, na gosaba ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
Kiswahili: Kama ukiweka mkono wako juu yake, utavikumbuka hivyo vita na kamwe hutarudia tena!
Ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao oyebwate, erio oteeme gokora esegi nero. Tokoiranera eria kabere.

English: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:
Kiswahili: Barua ilikabidhiwa kwa Elasa mwana wa Shafani, na kwa Gemaria mwana wa Hilkia, ambao Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda aliwatuma kwa Mfalme Nebukadneza huko Babeli. Barua yenyewe ilisema:
Ekegusii: Riruube erio rikaegwa Elasa, mosinto o Safani, na Gemaria, mosinto o Hilikia, abwo Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, atomete Babiloni ase Nebukadinesaro omorwoti. Aya naro amang’ana ariikire ase riruube erio.

English: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;
Kiswahili: Watu wa eneo lile walipomtambua Yesu, walipeleka habari sehemu zote za jirani. Watu wakamletea wagonjwa wao wote,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’orogongo roria bachia komomanya, bagatoma amang’ana ase chinsemo chionsi, bamorentere bonsi abarenge abarwaire;

English: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
Kiswahili: Ole wao! Kwa kuwa wanaifuata njia ya Kaini, wamekimbilia faida katika kosa la Balaamu na kuangamia katika uasi wa Kora.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo, ekiagera bagendererete ase enchera ya Kaini, na gwetuguta ase ogosaria kwa Baalamu ase engencho y’okonyora eng’eria, na barabwo basirire ase ogotaigwera gwa Kora.

English: 1 Now there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. 2 Near the Sheep Gate there is a pool called Bethesda, which has five porticoes. 3 Here lay a great number of people who were sick—blind, lame, paralyzed—waiting for the water to be stirred. 4 An angel would come down and stir the water, and whoever went in first would be healed. 5 One man was lying there who had been ill for thirty-eight years. 6 When Jesus saw him lying there and knew he had been there a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to get well?” 7 The sick man answered, “Sir, I have no one to help me get into the pool when the water is stirred. By the time I get there, someone else goes down ahead of me.” 8 Jesus told him, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.” 9 At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and began to walk. 10 It was the Sabbath day when this happened. 11 So the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “It is against our law for you to carry your mat on the Sabbath.” 12 He replied, “The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’” 13 They asked him, “Who is this who told you to pick it up and walk?” 14 Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, “See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.” 15 The man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well. 16 Because of this, the Jews persecuted Jesus and tried to kill him because he did such things on the Sabbath. 17 But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, and I also am working.” 18 For this reason the Jews tried all the more to kill him, because not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was also calling God his Father, making himself equal to God. 19 Then Jesus explained, “Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing. Whatever the Father does, the Son does also. 20 For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, and he will show him even greater works than these. 21 All those the Father gives me will come to me, and I will never reject anyone who comes to me. 22 For I have come down from heaven not to do my own will but to do the will of the one who sent me. 23 And this is the will of the one who sent me—that everyone who believes in me should have eternal life, and I shall raise them up on the last day.” 24 Very truly I tell you, whoever believes has eternal life now. 25 Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has already arrived when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live. 26 For just as the Father has life within himself, so he has granted the Son to have life within himself. 27 And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man. 28 So do not be surprised at my saying, “You must be born again.” 29 The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.” 30 “We know that you are a teacher come from God,” they replied. 31 Jesus answered, “Believe in me! If you believe, you will know that I am in my Father and my Father is in me.” 32 “These words I am saying to you are not just my own. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work. 33 Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works I have done. 34 I tell you the truth, whoever believes in me will do the same works I have done, and even greater ones. 35 Because I am going to the Father, and you will see me no longer. 36 Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father.” 37 Jesus answered, “Don’t you know me, Philip, even after I have been among you such a long time? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’? 38 Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words I say to you are not just my own. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work. 39 Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works I have done. 40 Don’t you believe that I am in the Father and that the Father is in me? 41 I tell you the truth, whoever believes in me will do the same works I have done, and even greater ones. 42 Do you believe that I am in the Father and that the Father is in me? 43 I have told you this, so that when it happens, you will believe. 44 But when the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth, who goes out from the Father—he will testify about me. 45 And I tell you the truth, whoever believes in me will also do what I have done. Indeed, they will do greater things, because I am going to the Father. 46 If you ask something of my Father in my name, he will give it to you. 47 Yet you don’t ask me anything.
Ekegusii: 1 Nyuma as'aya ndiarenge rituko rinene ri'Abayahudi; Yesu agatira kogenda Yerusalemu. 2 Naende aria Yerusalemu as'egesieri kie ching'ondi ndiarenge ritibo rikorokwa as'Ekeibirania Bethesaida, narirorio mbiarengeo ebisoero bitano. 3 Ime as'ebio mbarenge abanto abange abarwaire bakorara, emeuko, chirema, ab'ebimo biabo biomire, baganyete amache aseroke. 4 Naki ekero gete rilaika ngoika riarenge riasoa ase riria ritibo, koyaturubania amache: nabo ere oyore gosoa ritang'ani nyuma as'amache agoturubanigwa, igare kogwena oborwaire bwonsi obwamonyorete. 5 Narenge aroro omonto gete oyorenge noborwaire bw'emiaka emerongo etato netano netato. 6 Yesu agachia komorora oyio oraire, akamanya ng'a obaire engecho eye amatuko amange, akamotebia, Norigetie koba omogima? 7 Oria omorwaire akamoiraneria, Omonene, tindi nomonto okombeka ritibo ime, amache gagoturubanigwa: korende ekero ngochicha inche, omonto onde osoa ritang'ani asende. 8 Yesu akamotebia, Tenena, etweke egesero kiao, ogende. 9 Erio kegima omonto oria akaba omogima, agetweka egesero kiaye, akagenda. Nabo yarenge esabato rituko riria. 10 Abayahudi bakamotebia oria okonyetwe, Rero nesnbato, tari boronge asore gwetweka egesero kiao. 11 Akabairaneria, Ere oyonkora koba omogima nere ontebia, Etweke egesero kiao, ogende. 12 Bakamoboria, Oria ogotebia, Etweke egesero kiao ogende, ning'o? 13 Korende oria ogwenetigwe tamomanyete gose ning'o: naki Yesu erusananetie, ekiagera barenge abanto abange aas'aria. 14 Nyuma as'aya Yesu akamonyora hekalu itne, akamotebia, Rora, kwabaire omogima: tokora ebibe naende, ring'ana rire ribe kobua tiricha gokonyora. 15 Oria omonto akagenda, akabatebia Abayahudi amang'ana ng'a Yesu nere onkorete nkaba omogima. 16 As'ayio Abayahudi bagachaka komochanda Yesu, bakarigia komoita, ekiagera akora aya rituko ri'esabato. 17 Yesu akabairaneria, Tata one ngokorare emeremo nonya ngoika bono, nainche ngokorande emeremo. 18 Nabo ekiagera as'aya Abayahudi bakamenta korigia komoita, ekiagera atasareti esabato yoka, korende amo naya namorogete Nyasaye Tata oye, ogwekora koreng'ana buna Nyasaye. 19 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Omwana takonyara gokora ring'ana ere bweka, tatiga riria amororire Tata agokora: naki onsi agokora ere ayio naio n'Omwana agokora, 20 Naki Tata amwanchire Omwana, okomworokia onsi ayagokora omonyene: nemeremo emenene kobua eyeiga namworokie erinde inwe monyare gokumia. 21 Naki buna Tata akobibokia ebitondo nakobia obogima, naboigo n'Omwana akobaa obogima abarigetie. 22 Ekiagera Tata tari komogambia omonto onde bwonsi, korende omoire Omwana okogamba gwonsi; 23 erinde bonsi bamosike Omwana, buna bamosigete Tata. Oyotamosigeti Omwana tamosigeti Tata omotomete, 24 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, oyokoigwa ring'ana riane, nakomwancha ere oyontomete nare nobogima bwa kare nakare, gose tagoika as'ekina, korende oetire korwa as'amakweri goika as'obogima. 25 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ensa ngochere, nabono nere, ebitondo biraigwe eriogi ri'Omwana o Nyasaye; nabaria bakorigwa nababe moyo. 26 Naki buna Tata are nobogima ime yaye omonyene; naboigo omoeire n'Omwana koba nobogima ime yaye omonyene: 27 akamoa okobua kw'ogokora ekina ekiagera ere n'Omwana-o-mwanyabanto. 28 Timokumia as'aya: naki ensa ngochere, ekero abanto bonsi bare ase chimbera ime baraigwe eriogi riaye, 29 nabarabwo nabasoke; baria abare gokora amaya as'okobokigwa kw'obogima; nabaria abakorire amabe as'okobokigwa gw'ekina. 30 Inche omonyene tinkonyara gokora kende gionsi: buna nkoigwa, nabo nkogamba: nekina kiane iga kere boronge; ekiagera tindi koborigia obwanchani bwane, korende nobwanchani bwaye Tata oyontomete. 31 Inche kondetebe omonyene, ogoteba kwane tari okw'ekeene. 32 Nare oyonde oyokombera kirori; nainche namanyire ng'a oborori bwaye agonteba nobw'ekeene, 33 Inwe mwatomete abanto ase Yohana, noborori bwaye nekeene. 34 Korende inche tindi konyora oborori korwa as'abanto: korende iga ngokwana aya erinde inwe mokonyeke. 35 Ere igarenge etaya egwoka nakomoreka: nainwe mwanchire koyosasokera omobaso oye ekero egeke. 36 Korende oborori nde naborobwo nobonene, kobua boria bwa Yohana: naki emeremo eria naetwe na Tata inyekore, emeremo eyio eyio nayekorire, yambereire kirori ng'a Tata nere ontomete. 37 Nere Tata ontomete obaire kirori asende. Eriogi riaye timwanya korigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timorakerora; 38 naende ring'ana riaye timori narirorio ime yaino: naki inwe timwancheti ere oyotomirwe nere. 39 Iga mokorigiarigia mono amariko, ekiagera mokagete ng'a inwe more nobogima bwa kare nakare ime yaye, nayio naro are kirori asende; 40 ko mwangire gocha asende, monyare koba nobogima. 41 Tindi konyora obonene as'abanto. 42 Korende nabsmanyire inwe ng'a timori nobwanchani bwa Nyasaye ime yaino. 43 Inche nachire as'erieta ria Tata one nainwe timori konyancha: oyonde karache as'eiieta riaye omonyene, namomwanche oyio. 44 Naki moranyare gwancha inwe abamokoenana obonene inwe as'inwe, nobonene boria bokorua ase Nyasaye ore bweka timori koborigia? 45 Timokaga ng'a inche nimbasoere ase Tata: nare oyokobasoera, nere Musa, oyomosemeretie inwe. 46 Naki onye mwamwanchete Musa, anga mwanyancha inche; ekiagera nere origete amang'ana ane. 47 Korende motayancheti amariko aye, naki morayanche amang'ana ane?

English: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Esau akamwambia, “Ndugu yangu, tayari nina wingi wa mali. Ulivyo navyo viwe vyako mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Esau akamoiraneria: “Oyominto, echi mbwate nching’isaine. Echire echiao, kabe nachirochio.”

English: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa siku ya kisasi ilikuwa moyoni mwangu, mwaka wa ukombozi wangu umefika.
Ekegusii: Rituko ri’okorusia egesiomba nigo riarenge ase enkoro yane ime, na omwaka bw’okobooria abanto oikire.

English: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
Kiswahili: Hunifumbulia vinywa vyao wakisema, “Aha! Aha! Kwa macho yetu wenyewe tumeliona.”
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagwasamia emenwa yabo bateeba: “Ahaa! Ahaa! Ntwayarora namaiso aito.”

English: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘Yahweh says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
Kiswahili: Isaya akawaambia, “Mwambieni bwana wenu, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Usiogope kwa hayo uliyoyasikia, yale maneno ambayo watumishi wa mfalme wa Ashuru wamenitukana nayo.
Ekegusii: Isaya akabateebia, “Moteebie omonene oino ng’a Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Tobaisa kwoboa ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio kwaigure abasomba b’omorwoti bw’Abaasuri batebiire na kondama.

English: They set loaves upon the table, hung up the curtains, and finished all the work which they had done.
Ekegusii: Bakabeka emegati emesa igoro, bakabeeka ebitamba biogotuba na gokora emeremo yonsi barabwo baroberetie gokora.

English: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
Kiswahili: “Jihadharini mioyo yenu isije ikalemewa na anasa, ulevi na fadhaa za maisha haya, nayo siku ile ikawakuta ninyi bila kutazamia kama vile mtego unasavyo.
Ekegusii: “Nabo mwerende chinkoro chiaino tichicha koengerwa nokoria bobe na ogotinda, na okwerosia kw’obogima obo, rituko riria ribachere mobosokano, buna omoeto okobwata.

English: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
Kiswahili: Hivyo yule aliyekuwa ameketi juu ya lile wingu akauzungusha mundu wake duniani, nayo dunia ikavunwa.
Ekegusii: Na ere oyoikaransete igoro ase riire riria agasoyia omoyio oye ase ense, na ense ekageswa.

English: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
Kiswahili: “Ondoka uende katika mji mkubwa wa Ninawi, ukautangazie ujumbe ninaokupa.”
Ekegusii: Ere agateeba, “Imoka ogende Ninawi, omochie oria omonene, erio obararerie abanto amang’ana ayio nakoeire.”

English: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
Kiswahili: Si vyema kula asali nyingi sana, wala si heshima kujitafutia heshima yako mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Tari buya koria obooke obonge, na abwo bakwerigeria obonene, obonene bwabo nigo borabe bosa.

English: Their bodies were buried in peace. Their name lives to all generations.
Ekegusii: Emebere yaabo nigo yatindegetwe ase omorembe, amarieta abo nigo agendererete kobao ekiare ekemo goika ekende.

English: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Farao akasema, “Tazama, sasa watu hawa ni wengi, nanyi mnawazuia kufanya kazi.”
Ekegusii: Naende Farao akabora, “Abanto aba babeire abange kobua abanyene ense eye. Naende morigetie kobarusia ase emeremo yabo yobosomba.”

English: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Siku kwa siku mfalme wa Babeli alimpa Yehoyakini posho siku zote za maisha yake, hadi siku ya kifo chake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akamoa endagera yaye botambe na kera egento arenge kogania ase kera rituko ase obogima bwaye bwonsi goika ekero ki’ogokwa kwaye.

English: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Yahweh in ceasing to pray for you; but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari yangu, iwe mbali nami kutenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana kwa kushindwa kuwaombea. Mimi nitawafundisha njia iliyo njema na ya kunyooka.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio abe aare nainche ng’a ninkore ebibe ase Omonene ase ogotiga kobasabera inwe. Ribaga ri’ayio nimborokie enchera ere engiya na endonge.

English: Selemeng’ had many pots. How many pots did Selemeng’ have?
Ekegusii: Selemeng’ nigo abwate ebibusi ebinge. Ebibusi birenga Selemeng’ abwate?

English: Remember what Yahweh your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni kile Bwana Mungu wenu alichomfanyia Miriamu njiani baada ya ninyi kutoka Misri.
Ekegusii: Ayio onsi inche nabachiigete ng’a babateebie, goika moyakore. Inyora ay’Omonene Nyasae oino, akorerete Miriamu ekero mwarenge ase orogeendo rwaino korwa Misiri.

English: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yosefu akafa akiwa na umri wa miaka 110. Baada ya kumtia dawa ili asioze, akawekwa kwenye jeneza huko Misri.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu erio agakwa ore n’emiaka rigana erimo na ikomi (110). Bakamoaka amafuta, tabaisa kogunda, bakamobeeka ase esanduki ime aaria Misiri.

English: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”
Kiswahili: Lakini waoga, wasioamini, wachafu, wauaji, wazinzi, wachawi, waabudu sanamu, pamoja na waongo wote, mahali pao ni katika lile ziwa liwakalo moto na kiberiti. Hii ndiyo mauti ya pili.”
Ekegusii: Korende aboba, na abatari abegenwa, na abagechi, na abaiti, na abatomani, na abarogi, na abasasimi emegwekano na abanyaborimo bonsi; ensemo yabo nebe ase enyancha egwoka omorero na ekebiriti. Aya naro amakweri a kabere.”

English: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word:
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, tabiri dhidi ya manabii wa Israeli wanaotabiri sasa. Waambie hao ambao hutabiri kutokana na mawazo yao wenyewe: ‘Sikia neno la Bwana!
Ekegusii: “Aye mway abanto, bana mamincha y’ababani b’Abaisraeli, abwo bakobana amang’ana akorwa ase ebirengererio biabo abanyene, obateebie: Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!

English: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.
Kiswahili: Pia walikuwepo wengine watano: Hashuba, Oheli, Berekia, Hasadia na Yushab-Hesedi.
Ekegusii: Abamura bande batano ba Serubabeli nabwo aba: Hasuba na Oheli, Berekia na Hasadia, na Yusabi‐Hesedi.

English: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.
Kiswahili: Wote walifanya shauri pamoja kuja kupigana dhidi ya Yerusalemu, na kuchochea machafuko dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Bakabwatana amo bakabeekana omokia, erinde bagende bonsi amo ase okorwania Yerusalemu na koburukania abakori emeremo.

English: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.
Kiswahili: Wakati mmoja alipokuwa pamoja nao, aliwapa amri hii, “Msitoke Yerusalemu, bali ingojeni ahadi ya Baba, ambayo mmenisikia nikisema habari zake.
Ekegusii: Ekero asangererekanete amo nabarabwo, akabachiika tibabaisa korua Yerusalemu, akabateebia: “Moganye eira ya Tata, eria mwaigwete korwa ase ’nde.

English: Refugee camps must prioritize safety planning, adequate lighting, and women's participation in governance.
Kiswahili: Kambi za wakimbizi lazima zitoe kipaumbele katika kupanga usalama, taa za kutosha, na ushiriki wa wanawake katika utawala.
Ekegusii: Aaria chikambi chia baria batamire chisegi korwa chinsobo goika baroberie igoro yoborendi, oborabu boisaine ase chikambi chiabo, na gosangia abangina ase emeroberio yoborendi bwabo.

Ekegusii: Enchera endonke yokwami lotus ya Boindi n’ogotumia amagena akobwata kende korwa chirita chia amache 60 gose 80 chikoonogwa chiyuro 10 kera eyemo. Tumia enchera eyebeka chintetere chimerete ime y’esike ase gose omochanga ime y’enyongo y’amaoga omanye kobeka enyongo ime y’amagena. Konyora okwama okuya, ichoria amagena ayio n’amache.

English: Build better schools! Support infrastructure projects in ASAL regions.
Kiswahili: Jenga shule bora! Saidia miradi ya miundombinu katika mikoa ya ASAL.
Ekegusii: Agacha chinyomba chiokorara chiesukuru chiria abana benyete ime omwaka 2022.

English: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninaona kuna sheria nyingine inayotenda kazi katika viungo vya mwili wangu inayopigana vita dhidi ya ile sheria ya akili yangu. Sheria hii inanifanya mateka wa ile sheria ya dhambi inayofanya kazi katika viungo vya mwili wangu.
Ekegusii: korende ase ebiimo biane narorire ogochika konde nkoreo, gokorwana esegi n’ogochika gw’okomanya kw’ane na kogonkora koba omosakorwa bw’ogochika koria kw’ebibe kore ase ebiimo biane.

English: After this, David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”
Kiswahili: Ikawa baada ya mambo haya, Daudi akamuuliza Bwana, “Je, nipande kwenda katika mojawapo ya miji ya Yuda?” Bwana akasema, “Panda.” Daudi akauliza, “Je, niende wapi?” Bwana akajibu, “Nenda Hebroni.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Daudi akamoboori’Omonene, “Inee! Ndageenda ase omochie onde bw’Abayuda inyoire?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, geenda.” Naende Daudi akamobooria, “Norori?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Heburoni.”

English: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”
Kiswahili: Sitakufanya tena usikie dhihaka za mataifa, wala kudharauliwa na kabila za watu, wala kulifanya taifa lako lianguke, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’ ”
Ekegusii: Tinkogotiga osekererwe nabaanto b’ebisaku nonya ng’ake, gose togochaaywa n’abanto. Aye togotiga egesaku kiao kegwe. Nabo Omonene ateebire.”

English: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,
Kiswahili: ndipo utainua uso wako bila aibu; utasimama imara bila hofu.
Ekegusii: amaene, rirorio norigererie otari na komocha, naende norendwe buya tokoba nobwoba.

English: and that most justly, for he had tormented other men’s bowels with many and strange sufferings.
Ekegusii: eke naki egesusuro kebwenerete ase omonto oyio obeire kagochanda abanto bande ase okobaa emechando y’okwoboyia!

English: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.
Kiswahili: Hivyo siku hiyo Akishi akampa Daudi mji wa Siklagi, nao Siklagi umekuwa mali ya wafalme wa Yuda tangu wakati huo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase rituko riria Akisi akaa Daudi Sikilagi. Ase engencho eyio omochie oyio o Sikilagi nigo ore oyo bw’abarwoti b’Abayuda goika reero iga.

English: Parajubaea torallyi is a palm tree native to South America. Currently, it is mainly cultivated as an ornamental plant by collectors, Bolivia, where it has a significant economic importance due to its large seeds, which are used for oil extraction on the coast.
Ekegusii: Parajubaea torallyi n’omote omuya korwa Amerika ya maate. Korende, tori gosimekwa mono isiko y’ase yachakerete na abaremi, Bolivia, esengencho y’echintetere chiaye chinene, eyio emoneti rigori rinene ase ogoetigwa enyancha.

English: Know then that when a home is built, it is better than a rented house, because a rented house can be taken away from you anytime. Indeed, what is a rented house? Go and build yours.
Ekegusii: Bono buna omogaka oyo atweka mo iga, nigo kera omokung'u oye, arenge kominyoka gochia mwaye ogokobani. Inee, bono ogokobani ninki? Nabo oraborie.

English: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
Kiswahili: Heri wale ambao nguvu zao ziko kwako, na njia ziendazo Sayuni zimo mioyoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Mbare nomogooko abanto abwo bakonyora chinguru chiabo korwa asore; abwo chinkoro chiabo chiganetie kogenda Sayoni.

English: So then death works in us, but life in you.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, mauti inatenda kazi ndani yetu, bali uzima unatenda kazi ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: Gaki amakweri nigo agokora emeremo ime yaito, korende obogima ime yaino.

English: Where the sun shines, there is a good heart, give respect to those who came before us. Speak respectfully and let the children eat well, and be satisfied. Let us remember our ancestors and their descendants. Let us honor the elders and let us travel on boats with joy. The elder has dedication, give respect to those who have helped us with good hearts.
Ekegusii: Onde taiyo orakore buna abamagokoro, gochia ase abachokoro baye. Korwa ase ogotoinekera amatoke amatobu, na gotobisera. Gototigageria chinkara na gotoinekera ributi. Gotonyenyera engoko na gotoa ekebwato n' omosori. Ogotera oko n' dedication gochia ase baria basiririe abamagokoro.

English: Oh! She has given birth to a child!
Ekegusii: Obe! Naende eng'oge yatoberekirie omwana!

English: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, kwaherini. Kuweni wakamilifu, mkafarijike, kuweni wa nia moja, kaeni kwa amani. Naye Mungu wa upendo na amani atakuwa pamoja nanyi.
Ekegusii: Omoerio, abaminto, motigare buya. Mobe abaikeranu, moremigwe, mobe nomoyo oyomo, momenye ase omorembe. Na Nyasae bw’obwanchani na bw’omorembe abe amo nainwe.

English: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Mwandishi Shemaya mwana wa Nethaneli, Mlawi, aliorodhesha majina yao mbele ya Mfalme Daudi na maafisa: Kuhani Sadoki, Ahimeleki mwana wa Abiathari, na viongozi wa jamaa za makuhani na za Walawi: jamaa moja ikitoka upande wa Eleazari na nyingine upande wa Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Semaya, mosinto o Netaneli Omolawi, akarika amarieta abo agwo ekero omorwoti na abanene abarenge komokonya, na Zadoki Omokuani, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’abakuani, na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Chiamate chigachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera, eyemo korwa ase ororeria rw’Eleazari, na eyende korwa ase orwa Itamari.

English: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yoshua kutembea usiku kucha kutoka Gilgali, akawashambulia ghafula.
Ekegusii: Obotuko obogima Yoshua agataara korwa Giligali, akaumokera Abaamori mobosokano.

English: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mbona ninyi mnavunja amri ya Mungu kwa ajili ya mapokeo yenu?
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, Nase ki inwe mogosaria ogochika kwa Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino?

English: in pronouncing unjust judgment, condemning the innocent, and letting the guilty go free; although the Lord says, ‘You shall not kill the innocent and righteous.’
Ekegusii: Kwabeire gokonacha ebina bobe. Kwabeire gokogambia baria batari nokomocha na gotiga baria bare n’okomocha, nonya Nyasae kagoteeba buna tonachera omonto otari na komocha ekiina ki’ogokwa.’

English: Let them make haste and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids gush out with waters.
Kiswahili: Nao waje upesi na kutuombolezea, mpaka macho yetu yafurike machozi na vijito vya maji vitoke kwenye kope zetu.
Ekegusii: Abakungu abwo tiga baayerere gocha barere na kobokia amagombo ase tore, erinde amariga aiteke korwa ase amaiso aito, na amaiso aito aichorwe naro.

English: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.
Kiswahili: “Kisha atatoka aje kwenye madhabahu yaliyo mbele za Bwana na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake. Atachukua sehemu ya damu ya fahali na sehemu ya damu ya mbuzi, na kuiweka kwenye pembe za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio asoke agende ase egesasiimero kere agwo ase obosio bwane, agekorere okobwatanigwa, naende aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri gose ey’embori eyio, ayagindie ase emegwekano yonsi ye ching’unchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasiimero ekio,

English: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as Yahweh your God has commanded you;
Kiswahili: Waangamizeni kabisa Wahiti, Waamori, Wakanaani, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, kama Bwana Mungu wenu alivyowaamuru.
Ekegusii: Moite Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abakaanani, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, mobasirie kegima buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abachiigete.

English: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
Kiswahili: Yeyote amwaminiye hahukumiwi, lakini asiyeamini amekwisha kuhukumiwa, kwa sababu hakuliamini jina la Mwana pekee wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Oyomwegenire takogambigwa oyotegeneti oikire kogambigwa, ekiagera atariegeneti erieta ri’Omwana omomoima o Nyasae.

English: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
Kiswahili: “Kama moyo wangu umeshawishiwa na mwanamke, au kama nimevizia mlangoni mwa jirani yangu,
Ekegusii: Onye omoyo one obeire okoebererigwa na gwancha omokungu omoao, na igo nabeire nkoboera omonto onde ase egesieri kiaye imosirie,

English: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
Kiswahili: Niko pamoja nawe nami nitakulinda kila uendako na nitakurudisha katika nchi hii. Sitakuacha mpaka nitakapofanya hayo niliyokuahidi.”
Ekegusii: Rora, inche nimbe amo naye, ninkorende aande onsi ase orabe gokogenda, naende ninkoiranie gocha ase ense eye; naki tinkogotiga goika nagokoreire ayio nagoteebirie.”

English: At the end of seven years, every man of you shall release his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and has served you six years. You shall let him go free from you. But your fathers didn’t listen to me, and didn’t incline their ear.
Kiswahili: ‘Kila mwaka wa saba, kila mmoja wenu ni lazima amwache huru mtumwa ambaye ni Mwebrania mwenzenu aliyejiuza kwenu. Baada ya kukutumikia kwa miaka sita, ni lazima umwache huru aende zake.’ Hata hivyo baba zenu hawakunisikiliza wala kunijali.
Ekegusii: Ase omoerio bw’omwaka o gatano na kabere kera oyomo oino asibore Omoiberania, omonto omwabo, oyoonetigwe asare na obeire okomokorera ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo; ere goika aegwe obosibore. Korende chisokoro chiaino tichianyigwerete gose gotegerera chiigwe amang’ana aane.

English: Rarely did Matiang'i realize that people would support him so much; Gusii people have chosen Raila
Ekegusii: raria matiang’i buna nachie gotigara obowaziri buna abande barariigwe; abasomu ba Gusii babooririe Raila

English: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.
Kiswahili: “Wakati ulioamriwa, atavamia tena Kusini, lakini wakati huu matokeo yake yatakuwa tofauti na yale ya wakati wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: “Naende ase engaki echiikire nairane gochia ase ense ya Irianyi, korende ase engaki eyio amang’ana takoba buna ayio yeritang’ani.

English: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.
Kiswahili: hivyo Daudi akamuuliza Mungu tena, naye Mungu akamjibu, “Usiwapandie moja kwa moja, bali wazungukie na uwashambulie kutoka mbele ya hiyo miti ya miforosadi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aboretie Nyasae naende, Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobarwania esegi korwa aa, korende oetanane ogende obatubokere korwa magega ase emete ekorokwa balisamu ere.

English: 4The Lord has stirred up the spirit of Darius king of Persia, and he has ordered the rebuilding of this temple, and he has given them assistance, and the Holy One of God protects them.
Ekegusii: 2 Petr 3:5

English: They came to Holofernes’ tent, and said to him that was over all that he had, “Wake our lord up, now, for the slaves have been bold to come down against us to battle, that they may be utterly destroyed.”
Ekegusii: Abaanene abwo bakageenda ase enyomba ya Holoferne na komomanyia oria otenenerete amang’ana abene ya Holoferne; “Yeture ejamadari! Abasomba baria ba Israeli betiemire goocha ase esegi naintwe erinde intwe tobasirie!”

English: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu si kula na kunywa, bali ni haki, amani na furaha katika Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Inaki oborwoti bwa Nyasae tari okoria na okonywa, korende oboronge, na omorembe, na omogooko bikorwa ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
Kiswahili: Kila wakati Waisraeli walipopanda mazao mashambani, Wamidiani, Waamaleki na mataifa mengine ya mashariki walivamia nchi yao.
Ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi Abaisraeli barenge kobusura chimbusuro chiabo, Abamimidiani, n’Abaameleki, n’abanto ba moocha nigo baare goocha baabarwania esegi.

English: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mwisho wa wote ambao wanajipatia mali kwa hila; huuondoa uhai wa wale wenye mali.
Ekegusii: Naboigo omoerio bwe chiinchera chiabo ore, baria baganetie konyora chinibo ase ribero. Chinibo chiria nigo chigosiria obogima bw’abwo bagochinyora.

English: Biosecurity prevents disease outbreaks. Disinfect footbaths, quarantine new animals, control wildlife access, and report sick animals promptly. Proper carcass disposal is essential.
Kiswahili: Usalama wa kibiolojia huzuia milipuko ya magonjwa. Safisha vijidudu kwenye bafu za miguu, karantini wanyama wapya, dhibiti ufikiaji wa wanyamapori, na toa ripoti kwa wanyama wagonjwa haraka. Utupaji sahihi wa mizoga ni muhimu.
Ekegusii: Gotanga okoererania etugo korwa ensemo eyemo gochia eyende nigo egotana okwambokerana kwamarwaire yetugo nabanto. Beta chiombe esindani yoborwaire bwomonwa namagoro, chiombe chikorwaa gochia aria chichanche, renda chingiti chiorosana tichiika ange, na karwe eripoti ioro yetugo erwarete otrikonyorwa. Tindeka etugo eri yakure inse kabisa.

English: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?
Kiswahili: Manabii wanatabiri uongo, makuhani wanatawala kwa mamlaka yao wenyewe, nao watu wangu wanapenda hivyo. Lakini mtafanya nini mwisho wake?
Ekegusii: Abaabani nigo bakobana oborimo, na abakuani nigo bagwancherana namang’ana abo. Abanto baane nigo banchete amang’ana ayio, korende ninki morakore ekero omoerio orache?”

English: and he said to them, “Tell me now, you sons of Canaan, who are these people who dwell in the hill country? What are the cities that they inhabit? How large is their army? Where is their power and their strength? What king is set over them, to be the leader of their army?
Ekegusii: Akabateebia; inwe abanto ba Kaanani, nteebie na abanto bangeencho ki bamenyete ase ebitunwa ebi? Emechie neya ngeencho ki bamenyete? Obonge bwa abasikari baabo inaki bang’ana? Inaki bakonyora obobui nechinguru chiabo? Ning’o omorwoti obo okobaraa ase esegi?

English: These are the mourners:
Ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya:

English: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
Kiswahili: Baada ya kufanywa hai, alikwenda na kuzihubiria roho zilizokuwa kifungoni:
Ekegusii: Ase omoika oyo agachiera emeika eria yarenge ase obosibwa, akayeranderia.

English: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Usiku hautakuwako tena, wala hawatahitaji mwanga wa taa au wa jua, kwa maana Bwana Mungu atakuwa nuru yao, nao watatawala milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Obotuko tibokobao nonya ng’ake, tibaganeiri oborabu bw’etaya gose omobaso bw’erioba, ekiagera Omonene nabaabarerie omobaso, na barabwo nabagambe goika kare na kare.

English: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Sauti hii imesikika kwa faida yenu, wala si kwa faida yangu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akabora, “Eriogi eri tiricheti ase engencho yane, korende nase engencho yaino.

English: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of Yahweh made by fire and his portion.
Kiswahili: Makuhani ambao ni Walawi, yaani kabila lote la Lawi, hawatakuwa na mgawo wala urithi pamoja na Israeli. Wataishi kwa sadaka zitolewazo kwa ajili ya Bwana za kuteketezwa kwa moto, kwa maana huo ndio urithi wao.
Ekegusii: “Abakuani Abalawi n’egesaku gionsi ki’Abalawi tibakonyoora egetari gose omwando amo n’Abaisraeli baande. Nigo barabe bakoria ebing’wanso bigosambwa n’omorero ase Omonene na okoruegwa konde gokorentwa asaare.

English: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.
Kiswahili: Nitalithibitisha Agano langu kama Agano la milele kati yangu na wewe na wazao wako baada yako na vizazi vijavyo niwe Mungu wako na Mungu wa wazao wako.
Ekegusii: “Ning’ikeranie okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati yane naye, na ororeeria rwao korwa magega yao, kogenderera ekiaare ase ekiaare, kobe okobwatana gwa kare na kare; imbe Nyasae oo, na oyo bw’ororeeria rwao korwa magega yao.

English: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
Kiswahili: Au hamjasoma katika Sheria kwamba siku ya Sabato makuhani huvunja sheria ya Sabato Hekaluni lakini hawahesabiwi kuwa na hatia?
Ekegusii: Gose timwana gosoma ase amachiiko buna ase rituko ri’ Esabato abakuani be Hekalu nigo bagosaria Esabato, na barabwo tibakoba nokomocha?

English: Explain further, this thing that has fallen, you shouldn’t hide it from your fellow people. It is very important that people are forgiven when they confess their sins to their relatives, and they are remembered, and their names are written by the community leader.
Ekegusii: Enchera ende, oyo ogwete roche nere otagete korianani oy' omwabo oboremo. Esegeto enene neri buna abanto bari bagosinywa kogamberwa ekina na abamwabo, nigo bagotigwa, n' ekina kiabo kianyorwa n’ omobasokano omobe.

English: “Isn’t Yahweh your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Yahweh and before his people.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Je, Bwana Mungu wenu si yuko pamoja na ninyi? Pia si amewapa raha pande zote? Kwa maana amewatia wenyeji wa nchi mkononi mwangu, nayo nchi iko chini ya Bwana na watu wake.
Ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene, Nyasae oino, tari amo nainwe? Naende tabaete omorembe ase chinsemo chiaino chionsi? Ere obekire abanto abanyene ense eye ase okoboko kwane; na ense eye nkogambera yabekirwe inse y’Omonene na inse y’abanto baye.

English: 1. About the collection for the Lord’s people: do what I instructed the churches in Galatia.
Ekegusii: Inki toratebe rende? Ibrahimu sokoro yaito as'engecho y'omobere inki anyorire?

English: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
Kiswahili: Hao watu wengi watawapiga kwa mawe na kuwaua kwa panga zao, watawaua wana wao na binti zao na kuzichoma nyumba zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo mbaabaake amagena, naende mbaabaite nemioro yabo. Boigo mbaite abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, basambe chinyomba chiabo nomorero.

English: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
Kiswahili: Kama ameraruliwa na mnyama pori, ataleta mabaki ya mnyama kama ushahidi, naye hatadaiwa kulipa mnyama aliyeraruliwa.
Ekegusii: Onye omonyene abao ekero egoakwa gose egokwa, rirorio tagoakanwa. Onye etugo eyio yarenge eyogoakanerwa rirerio, ogoakanerwa okwo kobe kogoisanera ogosirerwa okwo.

English: Edwin son of Okong’o, a prominent person in the Gusii language and the author of the book "The Child of Eight," Mache Ng’umbu.
Ekegusii: Edwin bw’ Okong’o, Omosani omonene bwe Ekegusii nere omoriki bwo Omwana Oito o Mache Ng’umbu

English: This message is intended to reach those who understand and appreciate our traditions, and to remind the older generation of the Gusii people about the importance of cattle and small livestock as a blessing, providing food for the poor, bringing joy to the home.
Ekegusii: Obosemia obo bwarenge korwegwa gochia ase omoikeke na ng'ina biara ekero ki enyangi, nabio biagerete Abagusii abakoro bagateba buna Ng'ombe Na Mbori Chikane Korigia Magega Yaya, Korera Tarera Boreri Bobe, Bwoye Tagochongeria Mobere Osinye Bikoe.

English: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Kile kimtokacho mtu ndicho kimtiacho unajisi.
Ekegusii: Akabora “Ekegosoka korwa ase omonto nakio gekomobekera ogotacheneka.

Ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo ore korokwa Lidia; ere nigo arenge omosasiimi Nyasae. Nigo arwete omochie o Tiatira; naende nigo arenge omoonia bw’ebitambaa bimonyinga. Omokungu oyo nigo arenge omosasiima o Nyasae. Ere agatotegerera. Omonene akaigora enkoro y’omokuungu oria, erinde akaigwa na gwancha amang’ana Paulo arenge gokwana.

English: The Senate committee has invited interested parties to submit their views on the matter of the large amount of money in the aforementioned parliament of Kipchumba Murkomen and regarding the committee of eleven people accused of corruption, which was also raised in the county assembly of Kiambu concerning the governor of that county, Ferdinand Waititu, being accused.
Ekegusii: Ebunge ye esenate yatuguteire are amagani yo omorai bwo omobaro omonene ase ebunge eyio kipchumba murkomen yo okogania ekomiti ya abanto 11 koroisigwa gochi gotuka engana yaetigwa ne ebunge ye ecounty ya kiambu komogania omogavana bwe ecounty eyio Ferdinand waititu korusigwa obisi.

English: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.
Kiswahili: Nayo yale maji yakaponywa mpaka leo, sawasawa na neno la Elisha alilokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio amaache aria akagwenigwa na akagenderera koba amaya goika reero iga, buna Elisha ateebete.

English: Good evening: With PETRONILLAH OGOTI. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Published [ January ] 15, 2014
Ekegusii: Buna twakabeire: Na PETRONILLAH OGOTI. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Engatiato [ January ] 15, 2014

English: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
Kiswahili: Jiweke huru, kama swala mkononi mwa mwindaji, kama ndege kutoka kwenye mtego wa mwindaji.
Ekegusii: minyoka buna engabi egotama erue ase omotwari, na buna enyoni egotama erue ase omotegi.

English: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke alipoona kwamba Yosefu amemwachia vazi lake mkononi na kukimbilia nje ya nyumba,
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria, ekero arooche ng’a Yusufu omotigeire eanga yaye koboko kwaye, na gotama gochia isiko,

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023

English: CBK warns Kenyans against sending money to social media groups promising weekly payouts from investment plans. These are unregulated and illegal.
Kiswahili: CBK inawaonya Wakenya dhidi ya kutuma pesa kwa vikundi vya mitandao ya kijamii na kuahidi malipo ya kila wiki kutoka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji. Hizi hazidhibitiwi na ni kinyume cha sheria.
Ekegusii: Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) yakureire abaKenya igoro yogotoma chibesa gochia chigurupu chiembeo bakobangaina konyora obwaita kera ewiki. Ebinto binga buna ebio tibiri bia amachiko igo nebiobong'ainereria.

English: And people have come together to solve their problems and aid others, and 15 people were arrested for spreading rumors, and this news spread quickly within 45 days.
Ekegusii: Na baria baganeti gochia gokora enyanyi yabo ase aigoir, nigo abanto 15 boka barancherwe goikerana, nomoyega oyio koira chidageka 45 chioka

English: The people of the city gathered themselves together into the midst of the city, to the number of one hundred and twenty thousand men, and they wanted to kill the king.
Ekegusii: ekiagera konye omsangererekano bwa abanto 120,000 babwatanire bamoite omorwoti.

English: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
Kiswahili: Huyo Lazaro alitamani kujishibisha kwa makombo yaliyoanguka kutoka mezani kwa yule tajiri. Hata mbwa walikuwa wakija na kuramba vidonda vyake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge kogania kweigotia namatori are kogwa korwa ase emesa y’omonda oria, ne chisese nachirochio chicha chiamomena amaote aye.

English: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mose akasema na Waisraeli, nao viongozi wao wakampa fimbo kumi na mbili, fimbo moja kwa ajili ya kila kabila la baba zao, nayo fimbo ya Aroni ikiwa miongoni mwa hizo.
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Abaisraeli, akabateebia amang’ana ayio, na abaraai bonsi be chiamate chia kera egesaku bakamoa chinyimbo chiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, na enyimbo ya Aroni nigo yarenge ase egati ye chinyimbo chiria.

English: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
Kiswahili: ili kuonyesha rehema kwa baba zetu na kukumbuka Agano lake takatifu,
Ekegusii: erinde abarorere amaabera chisokoro chiaito, na koinyora okobwatana kwaye ogochenu.

English: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.
Kiswahili: Ninajua kwamba kila kitu anachokifanya Mungu kitadumu milele, hakuna kinachoweza kuongezwa au kupunguzwa. Mungu hufanya hivyo ili watu wamche yeye.
Ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a gento kende gionsi Nyasae agokora nigo gekogenderera kobao kare na kare; gento kende tigekomentwa ase ekio, gose kende tigekorusigwa korwa ase ekio. Nyasae nere okorire igo, erinde Mwanyabaanto bamoiroke.

English: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwategemeza wote waangukao, na huwainua wote waliolemewa na mizigo yao.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobwata bonsi abakogwa, nigo akogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse.

English: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Ish-Boshethi akatoa amri kwamba Mikali achukuliwe kutoka kwa Paltieli mumewe, mwana wa Laishi.
Ekegusii: Erio Isi‐Boseti agatoma abanto barusie omokungu oria korwa ase Palitieli, omosacha oye, mosinto o Laisi.

English: David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
Kiswahili: Daudi akayainua macho yake akamwona huyo malaika wa Bwana akiwa amesimama katikati ya mbingu na dunia, naye ameunyoosha upanga wake juu ya Yerusalemu tayari kuangamiza. Kisha Daudi na wazee, waliokuwa wamevaa nguo za gunia, wakaanguka kifudifudi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akarigereria akarora omomalaika oria bw’Omonene oteneine gati y’ense na igoro; ere nabwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye okoramborete gochia igoro ya Yerusalemu, na Daudi na abagaaka babegete chianga chi’echigunia, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.

English: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kupanga siku ya kuonana naye, watu wengi wakaja kuanzia asubuhi hadi jioni akawaeleza na kutangaza kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu akijaribu kuwahadithia juu ya Yesu kutoka Sheria ya Mose na kutoka Manabii.
Ekegusii: Kobachorire rituko nere, abanto abange mono bagacha asare aase amenyete. Akabateebereria korwa mambia goika mogoroba, na koorokia amang’ana igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, agateema kobateebereria amang’ana igoro ya Yeso korwa ase amang’ana ’amachiiko a Musa na korwa ase ababani.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose: “Niletee wazee sabini wa Israeli, unaowafahamu kama viongozi na maafisa miongoni mwa watu. Walete katika Hema la Kukutania, ili waweze kusimama huko pamoja nawe.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Sangereria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etan’ebere, abwo basikire, bamanyekanete bare abatang’ani b’ abanto, obarente agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, batenene aroro amo naye.

English: Marsabit areas under security declaration; comply with rules.
Kiswahili: Maeneo ya Marsabit chini ya tamko la usalama; zingatia sheria.
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chia Marsabit chiabekirwe inse yoborendi bweserikari; igwera amachiko yoborendi.

English: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
Kiswahili: Akaenda zake nyumbani akamkuta binti yake amelala kitandani, yule pepo mchafu akiwa amemtoka.
Ekegusii: Akagenda mwaye, akanyora omwana oria bwareirie borere, na ekerecha keria kiamorure.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2024

English: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron, and part of clay.
Ekegusii: Amagoro aye nigo aroisetigwe korwa ase ebioma, na ebisanyi bi’amagoro nigo biarenge ekeng’ese ki’ebioma, na ekeng’ese ki’amaroba.

English: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in Yahweh’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it and his habitation;
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akamwambia Sadoki, “Rudisha Sanduku la Mungu mjini. Ikiwa nitapata kibali mbele za Bwana, atanirudisha, nami nitaliona Sanduku hili tena pamoja na Maskani yake.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agateebia Zadoki, “Bogoria Esanduki ya Nyasae, oyeiranie ase omochie ime. Onye ’nkonyora ogwancherwa ase Omonene, ere nang’iranie, ayenyorokie naende amo n’Obomenyo bwaye omonyene.

English: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
Kiswahili: Umeutukuza mkono wa kuume wa adui zake, umewafanya watesi wake wote washangilie.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakomochanda aye kwabaeire chinguru chinyinge, na kwagerire ababisa baye bonsi bagoke.

English: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on Yahweh your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on Yahweh your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.
Kiswahili: Leteni sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wenu, vyote nyama na damu. Damu ya dhabihu zenu lazima imiminwe kando ya madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wenu, lakini nyama mnaweza kula.
Ekegusii: Morue ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, chinyama amo n’amanyinga, igoro ase egesasiimero kia Omonene Nyasae oino. Amanyinga y’ebing’wanso biaino binde, moyaumore igoro ase egesasiimero kia Omonene Nyasae oino, korende chinyama chirochio morie.

English: So he brought down the people to the water; and Yahweh said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Gideoni akalileta lile jeshi chini kwenye maji naye Bwana akamwambia Gideoni, “Watenge upande mmoja wale wote wanywao maji kwa ulimi, kama vile mbwa anywavyo, wale wote wapigao magoti ili kunywa wakipeleka mikono yao vinywani mwao, waweke upande mwingine.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo Gidioni agatirimbokia abanto baria gochia rooche, n’Omonene akamoteebia, “Onde bwensi oraabe ogosiara amaache n’oromeme gochia monwa oye, buna esese egosiara, omobeeke ensemo eyemo; na onde bwensi oratung’ame inse namaru konywa amaache, omobeeke ensemo eng’ao.”

English: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.
Kiswahili: Mara mji wote ukajaa ghasia. Wakawakamata Gayo na Aristarko, watu wa Makedonia waliokuwa wakisafiri pamoja na Paulo, na watu wakakimbilia katika ukumbi wa michezo kama mtu mmoja.
Ekegusii: Omochie bwonsi ogaichorwa neburu‐buru, bakabwata Gayo na Aristariko, abanto ba Makedonia, baare gotaara amo na Paulo, bakabakurura na bakaminyoka amo gochia aase chigosori chigokorerwa.

English: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
Kiswahili: Mwe waangalifu msipuuze jambo hili. Kwa nini kuruhusu tishio hili kuendelea na kusababisha hasara kwa ufalme?
Ekegusii: Timobaisa goteebana ase amang’ana aya. Nase ki inche omorwoti ndanyore emechando?”

English: Women in agriculture face distinct risks. Cooperatives should adopt prevention policies and reporting options.
Kiswahili: Wanawake katika kilimo wanakabiliwa na hatari tofauti. Vyama vya ushirika vinapaswa kupitisha sera za kuzuia na chaguzi za kuripoti.
Ekegusii: Abakungu bagokora emeremo ase oboremi nigo bare ase okonyorwa nemechando yabeene. Ebiombe bioboremi nere buya bitabe amachiko yogotanga nenchera yokorwa chiripoti.

English: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.
Kiswahili: Wale mabeberu waliokuwa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi wakaletwa mbele ya mfalme na kusanyiko nao wakaweka mikono yao juu hao mabeberu.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarenta chigoree chiria chi’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase omorwoti na ase omosangererekano, na barabwo bakabeeka amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe ye chigoree echio.

English: For whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh. Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God drives them out from before you.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote afanyaye mambo haya ni chukizo kwa Bwana, tena ni kwa sababu ya matendo haya ya kuchukiza wayafanyayo ndiyo maana Bwana Mungu wenu atayafukuza mataifa hayo mbele yenu.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi orakore ebinto ebi nigo arabe okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae, n’a ase engencho y’okogeechia buna okwo, Omonene oino naseerie abanto abwo konya bamenyete ase ense eria, barue ase amasio aino.

English: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
Kiswahili: Basi Hanuni akawakamata watu wa Daudi, akawanyoa kila mmoja ndevu zake nusu, akakata mavazi yao nyuma katikati kwenye matako, akawaacha waende zao.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Hanuni akabwata abasomba abwo ba Daudi, akagingira chinderu chiabo ensemo eyemo, na akanacha chianga chiabo agachiikia ebinema, akabaseria bagende.

English: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”
Kiswahili: Wajua Abneri mwana wa Neri alikuja kukudanganya na kuchunguza nyendo zako na kupata kila kitu unachokifanya.”
Ekegusii: Tomanyeti Abineri, mosinto o Neri? Ere igo acha aa gokong’aina, naende amanye chinsemo ase okogeenda na ebinto ebi ogokora.”

English: For both we and our words are in his hand, with all understanding and skill in various crafts.
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore ase amaboko aye amo namang’ana aito, chisemi chiaito boigo nonya noboroisia bwaito.

English: But Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
Kiswahili: Lakini Abiya akapata nguvu. Alioa wanawake kumi na wanne na alikuwa na wana ishirini na wawili na binti kumi na sita.
Ekegusii: Abiya akanyora chinguru chinyinge, akanyuoma abakungu ikomi na baane; akaiborerwa abana abamura emerongo ebere na babere, na abaiseke ikomi na batano nomo.

English: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
Kiswahili: Huu ni ubaya ulio katika kila kitu kinachotendeka chini ya jua: Mwisho unaofanana huwapata wote. Zaidi ya hayo, mioyo ya watu, imejaa ubaya na kuna wazimu mioyoni mwao wangali hai, hatimaye huungana na waliokufa.
Ekegusii: Obo nabwo obobe ase aya onsi agokorekana aiga inse y’erioba, ng’a egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi; chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto nigo chiichire obobe na obobarimo ekero bare moyo, na magega y’ayio nigo bakogeenda ase abakuure.

English: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,
Kiswahili: Pia akamtengenezea Aroni na wanawe makoti ya kitani safi, kazi ya mfumaji,
Ekegusii: Bakaroiseria Aroni amo nabamura baye chiganchwa chi’egatani engiya,

English: “For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me. My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.”
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo sababu ninalia na macho yangu yanafurika machozi. Hakuna yeyote aliye karibu kunifariji, hakuna yeyote wa kuhuisha roho yangu. Watoto wangu ni wakiwa kwa sababu adui ameshinda.”
Ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’amang’ana aya nigo nkorera, amaiso aane nigo akoiyeria amariga, oyio okondemia nigo are aare korwa ase ’nde, oyio okong’a chinguru chinyia; abana bane batigaire bare boka, ekiagera ababisa bane bambuire.”

English: Jared Nyabuto Nyaberi.
Ekegusii: Jared Nyabuto Nyaberi.

English: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
Kiswahili: katika utakatifu na haki mbele zake, siku zetu zote.
Ekegusii: ase obochenu na ase oboronge ase obosio bwaye amatuko aito onsi.

English: Academic findings on drivers of COP success and constraints in Migori County's Nyumba Kumi program
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya kitaaluma kuhusu vichocheo vya mafanikio na vikwazo vya COP katika mpango wa Nyumba Kumi wa Kaunti ya Migori
Ekegusii: Amasomo abeene aorokirie buna omosangerekano bwabasangi ase oborendi (COP) bwakonyire gokeania emechando aaria ekaonti ya Migori goetera omoroberio O'Nyumba Kumi.

English: to bring upon us great plagues such as never happened before under the whole heaven, as it came to pass in Jerusalem, according to the things that are written in the law of Moses,
Ekegusii: Ande taiyo ense eng’ima ring’ana riana koba buna eri riabeire Yerusalemu, Omonene nigo akorete aria arigetwe ase amachiiko a Musa.

English: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
Ekegusii: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

English: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.
Kiswahili: Kwenye vichaka walilia kama punda, na walijisongasonga pamoja kwenye vichaka.
Ekegusii: Ime ase ebitutu nigo bakwogererana, inse y’amase akorura nao bagosangererekana amo.

English: So he killed these men for having turned traitors, and immediately took possession of the two towers.
Ekegusii: Agwo agwo agaita abanto abwo erio akaboera chindwaki chiria ibere.

English: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
Kiswahili: Kwa wale waliooana nawapa amri (si mimi ila ni Bwana): Mke asitengane na mumewe.
Ekegusii: Korende baria baikire konyuomana nabachiikire, gose tari inche, korende Omonene, ng’a omokungu tatiga omosacha oye,

English: So the Lord has commanded that those who preach the gospel should be supported by the gospel.
Ekegusii: korende tari kobua as'amanyinga aye Kristo, ere as'Omoika obotambe akerwa omonyene ase Nyasaye koba ekeng'wanso getari nakemoa, gosibia ebirengererio biaino korwa emeremo ekwete, komokorera Nyasaye ore moyo?

English: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”
Kiswahili: Kisha mtanajisi sanamu zenu zilizofunikwa kwa fedha, na vinyago vyenu vilivyofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Mtazitupilia mbali kama vitambaa vya wakati wa hedhi na kuziambia, “Haya, tokeni hapa!”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio moimokie emegwekano yaino mogosasiima, eyio ebachire na koomwa ne chifeta, na eyende ebombire na koomwa netaabu, moyetugute buna ebinto bitachenegeti, moyetebie: “Karue aa ase tore!”

English: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kwa ajili ya Daudi baba yako, sitafanya jambo hili wakati wa uhai wako. Nitaurarua kutoka mikononi mwa mwanao.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho ya Daudi ise tingokora ayio ase amatuko ao, korende nigo ndabotandorane korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oo.

English: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
Kiswahili: Hujikunyata na kuvizia kama simba, kama simba jike; nani anayethubutu kumwamsha? “Abarikiwe kila akubarikiye, na alaaniwe kila akulaaniye!”
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli nigo batung’aime inse buna endo, buna endo eaberi, ning’o oraabe noboremu abature? Asesenigwe omonto oria okobasesenia inwe, na aragererigwe omonto oria okobaragereria inwe.”

English: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
Kiswahili: Je, mkono wangu haukufanya vitu hivi vyote?’
Ekegusii: Inee! Tari okoboko kwane gwakorete ebinto ebi bionsi?

English: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
Kiswahili: Wakamtemea mate, wakachukua ile fimbo wakampiga kichwani tena na tena.
Ekegusii: Erio bakamotwera amate, bakaimokia egetonto keria, bakamoaka ase omotwe.

English: For you have not yet escaped the judgment of the Almighty God who sees all things.
Ekegusii: Tokonyara gwetanga korwa ase endamwamu ya Nyasae omonguru oyio okorora onsi.

English: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo binti za Selofehadi wakafanya kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.
Ekegusii: Abaiseke ba Selofehadi bagakora buna Omonene Nyasae amochiigete Musa.

There is none. Many birds disturb the farmers. The inspection team visited approximately 44 farmers. Most of them filled out the forms properly. They were grateful for the support from Farm Africa, Kenya Industrial Research Development Institute (Kirdi), International Service for Acquisition of Agri-biotechnology Application (Isaaa) and Kenya Gatsby Trust. Banyorire ogokonywa korwa ase Farm Africa, Kenya Industrial Research Development Institute (Kirdi), International Service for Acquisition of Agri-biotechnology Application (Isaaa) na Kenya Gatsby Trust. English: David sent the people out, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. The king said to the people, “I will also surely go out with you myself.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akatuma vikosi vya askari: theluthi moja ilikuwa chini ya amri ya Yoabu, theluthi ya pili chini ya Abishai mwana wa Seruya nduguye Yoabu, na theluthi ya tatu chini ya Itai, Mgiti. Mfalme akaviambia vikosi, “Hakika mimi mwenyewe nitakwenda pamoja nanyi.”
Ekegusii: Erio agatoma abarwani bageende korwana esegi, bare ebiombe bitato, ekemo inse y’oboraai bwa Yoabu, ne egia kabere inse y’oboraai bw’Abisai, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, oyorenge ng’ina Yoabu boigo, na ekia gatato inse y’oboraai bwa Itai korwa Gati. English: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hela walikuwa: Serethi, Sohari, Ethnani,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hela nabwo aba: Sereti na Isihari, na Etinani.

English: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.
Kiswahili: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya na watu wa Daudi wakatoka na kukutana nao kwenye bwawa la Gibeoni. Kikundi kimoja kiliketi upande mmoja wa bwawa, na kikundi kingine upande wa pili.
